'''Cravel''' was a thief who, along with his partner [[Blackie (junkyard owner)|Blackie]], commandeered a [[Blackie's|junkyard]] in [[Vorrnti City]] with the intention of fixing up a derelict [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] it contained and using the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] to steal some [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. They were thwarted by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Katarn Commandos]], however, and were [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] by the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] before Calrissian claimed the AT-AT as his own.
